name: Reliability, Safety & Risk Engineering
summary: Quantifying and improving how long machines last and how safely they fail: life data analysis, FMEA, fault trees, testing and machinery safety standards.

topics.name: Reliability concepts: failure rate, MTTF/MTBF and the bathtub curve
Life distributions (exponential, Weibull, lognormal) and Weibull analysis of test data
System reliability: series, parallel, k-out-of-n and redundancy
Fault tree and event tree analysis
Reliability testing: accelerated life testing, HALT/HASS, reliability growth
Machine safety and risk assessment (ISO 12100); guarding
Safety standards for robots and personal-care devices (ISO 10218, ISO 13482) and product liability
